description: This file defines SwiftUI views for displaying and interacting with transcript text, including a text view that supports editing, scrolling, and custom behaviors, as well as a vibrant label with tap detection.

classes.name: TranscriptNSTextView
classes.description: A custom NSTextView subclass that handles special key events such as return, escape, and command+return for sending messages, editing interactions, and escape behaviors.

classes.name: ClickCatcher
classes.description: An NSView subclass that detects mouse clicks to trigger tap actions.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates a Coordinator object to act as NSTextView delegate.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSScrollView containing a TranscriptNSTextView, setting up layout and behavior.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSScrollView and its contained NSTextView with new attributed text when required.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Detects mouse clicks in ClickCatcher view to trigger the onTap callback.

methods.name: becomeFirstResponder
methods.description: Overrides to handle actions when NSTextView gains focus, triggering onBeginEditing.

methods.name: resignFirstResponder
methods.description: Overrides to handle actions when NSTextView loses focus, triggering onEndEditing.

methods.name: keyDown
methods.description: Custom key handling in TranscriptNSTextView, especially for Escape, Return, and Command+Return keys.
